name: Matrix Zero Divisors
text: For all 2x2 integer matrices A and B, if A*B = 0 then A = 0 or B = 0.

name: Graph Chromatic Lower Bound
text: Every finite graph with minimum degree at least 3 has chromatic number >= 4.

name: Euler Polynomial Factorization
text: The polynomial n^2 - n + 41 produces primes for all integers n.

name: Strict Positive Quadratic Form
text: For all real x and y, x^2 - 2x + y^2 + 2 > 0.
